route.boat.alten-corimont-helstrom.name: the Onkobra reach
route.boat.alten-corimont-helstrom.notes: The guarded channel of the MQ05 escorted convoy; the Shadowfen reach of the Onkobra south of Alten Corimont.

route.boat.archon-estuary.name: the Archon estuary
route.boat.archon-estuary.notes: The estuary that feeds the provincial centre; root-transit station root-east-estuary sits on it.

route.boat.blackrose-lake-ferry.name: the lake stage
route.boat.blackrose-lake-ferry.notes: The city ferry concession across the eleven-kilometre lake, calling at Longmont and the Spine rather than going round.

route.boat.blackrose-lilmoth.name: the Oliis river
route.boat.blackrose-lilmoth.notes: Blackrose's south-flowing river toward Oliis Bay (waters.md: the three-river confluence).

route.boat.deeps-inner-poling-line.name: the inner poling line
route.boat.deeps-inner-poling-line.notes: The guided channel across the inner swamp: hire stage to Dead-Water Village via the Polers' Camp. Geometry awaits compile_minor_routes.
sources: world/sources/catalogue/places-naga-kur-deeps.json (The Hire Stage, Dead-Water Village, The Polers' Camp)
uesp:Lore:Argonian (poling craft and guided marsh travel)

route.boat.gideon-onkobra.name: the Onkobra white water
route.boat.gideon-onkobra.notes: Canon west-to-east river from near Topal Bay through Gideon; canoe channel, not a lane.

route.boat.lilmoth-anchorage.name: the Lighter run
route.boat.lilmoth-anchorage.notes: Canon: big hulls cannot dock at Lilmoth, so everything is lightered between the deep anchorage and the quay.

route.boat.lilmoth-archon.name: the Oliis coast
route.boat.lilmoth-archon.notes: Out of Oliis Bay (Jel: Tikmak) and up the Padomaic shore.

route.boat.lilmoth-keel-sakka.name: the Keel-Sakka
route.boat.lilmoth-keel-sakka.notes: Inland from Lilmoth; the Tum-Taleel bridge toll (waters.md).

route.boat.oliis-crossing.name: the Estuary crossing
route.boat.oliis-crossing.notes: The half-mile ferry across the Oliis estuary on the coast road; older than the rebuilt city.

route.boat.soulrest-blackrose.name: Bramman's river
route.boat.soulrest-blackrose.notes: Canon navigable interior route (the Imperial Navy sailed it in 1E 1033); Phase 4's lane solver did not keep it — a Part 3c boat-lane candidate when the water graph is re-solved.

route.boat.soulrest-lilmoth.name: the Southern Sea run
route.boat.soulrest-lilmoth.notes: Coastal sail between the two Southern Sea cities; Khajiit pirates keep a low profile here (waters.md).

route.boat.stormhold-alten-corimont.name: the Shadowfen channels
route.boat.stormhold-alten-corimont.notes: Stormhold's river network down to the freehold.

route.road.alten-corimont-stormhold.name: the Corimont road
route.road.alten-corimont-stormhold.notes: The offshoot from the Border road down to the freehold; the opening hours' only road out (docs/research/opening-hours-and-start-area.md).

route.road.archon-gideon.name: the Long road
route.road.archon-gideon.notes: The interior crossing; the province's longest single leg.

route.road.blackrose-lilmoth.name: the Prison road
route.road.blackrose-lilmoth.notes: Imperial-penal-south administrative register: the road the cordons used.

route.road.bone-road-waystation-the-coun.name: the bone road
route.road.bone-road-waystation-the-coun.notes: The western carry: staged a day apart, walked, never carted.

route.road.cartwrights-cross-fig-market.name: the north track
route.road.cartwrights-cross-fig-market.notes: The cart track off the Blackwood Road to the marsh-edge market; geometry awaits compile_minor_routes.

route.road.deeps-narrows-drag.name: the Drag
route.road.deeps-narrows-drag.notes: The hauled portage across the neck at the narrows; land route, hulls on bog-oak rollers.

route.road.gideon-blackwood-road.name: the Blackwood Road
route.road.gideon-blackwood-road.notes: The canon exit road to Leyawiin; playable edge closed (00-core acceptance rules).

route.road.gideon-ridge-runners-post.name: the Rim path
route.road.gideon-ridge-runners-post.notes: The runners' line north along the rim; no cart can use it, which is why letters go this way.

route.road.gideon-soulrest.name: the Bog causeway
route.road.gideon-soulrest.notes: Flood-damaged legs are bridged or ferried, never absent (acceptance rule).

route.road.gideon-stormhold.name: the Rim road
route.road.gideon-stormhold.notes: Skirts the western upland rim between the two frontier cities.

route.road.glenbridge-the-road-nisswo-ho.name: the sermon road
route.road.glenbridge-the-road-nisswo-ho.notes: The pilgrim walk to the Sermon Xanmeer, kept by nisswo houses at walking intervals.

route.road.helstrom-blackrose.name: the Bogmother causeway
route.road.helstrom-blackrose.notes: Named for the Bogmother shrine the catalogue places on it.

route.road.stormhold-thorn.name: the Border road
route.road.stormhold-thorn.notes: The two Morrowind-facing cities' trunk; dunmer-north English-compound register.

route.road.thorn-tear-road.name: the Tear road
route.road.thorn-tear-road.notes: Canon exit toward Tear in Morrowind; playable edge closed.

route.track.blackrose-cordon-line.name: the cordon line
route.track.blackrose-cordon-line.notes: The Knahaten Flu cordon's own patrol path, still walked between the hundred-pace marker stones from the hills to the water.

route.track.bogmother-causeway.name: the Bogmother causeway
route.track.bogmother-causeway.notes: Stone causeway from Stormhold to the xanmeer, ending in a ferry at the Black Stage.

route.track.dres-slave-road.name: the old Dres road
route.track.dres-slave-road.notes: The Dres coffle road out of Morrowind. Legally dead, physically intact, and Sump Rows is on it.

route.track.gravel-six-ferry.name: the Gravel Six rope
route.track.gravel-six-ferry.notes: A rope ferry that only works in the wet months, which is when the hamlet needs it.

route.track.hissmir-pilgrim-water.name: the pilgrim water
route.track.hissmir-pilgrim-water.notes: The poled water route pilgrims take to the trial village; deliberately easy to find.

route.track.hutan-tzel-totem-line.name: the totem line
route.track.hutan-tzel-totem-line.notes: Totem-marked channel line downstream; needs a village guide to read.

route.track.last-landing-carry.name: the Last Landing carry
route.track.last-landing-carry.notes: Where the sill stops hulls, porters carry inland; the whole reason the landing exists.

route.track.mercantile-coast.coast-road.name: the Coast road
route.track.mercantile-coast.coast-road.notes: The landward coast road between the two southern ports, counted in Imperial stages from Soulrest; no geometry until the minor-route compiler runs.

route.track.mercantile-coast.lilmoth-nor.name: the North Gate road
route.track.mercantile-coast.lilmoth-nor.notes: Out of Lilmoth’s north gate to the head of poling water on the Keel-Sakka; the customs suburb and the beast ground sit on it.

route.track.mercantile-coast.nisswo-line.name: the Nisswo line
route.track.mercantile-coast.nisswo-line.notes: The walked pilgrim line to the Teeth of Sithis; Xal-Meht and the glow-fen are stages on it, and it is walked at night.

route.track.mercantile-coast.porters-car.name: the Porters’ carry
route.track.mercantile-coast.porters-car.notes: Portered cargo above the gravel sill where the river stops carrying hulls.

route.track.north-shadowfen-rootworm-lin.name: the north rootworm line
route.track.north-shadowfen-rootworm-lin.notes: The tamed rootworm run through the north marsh; the Wild Mouth lies off it.

route.track.rim-ledge-crossing.name: the ledge crossing
route.track.rim-ledge-crossing.notes: The uncounted ledge line parallel to the pass, a person wide and no beasts.

route.track.rose-causeway.name: the Rose causeway
route.track.rose-causeway.notes: The single causeway across open marsh to Blackrose Prison, watched from the moment you step on it; carries the supply town's ration traffic and passes the outworks.

route.track.tear-pass-carry.name: the pass carry
route.track.tear-pass-carry.notes: Porter stages over the saddle into Morrowind; carts stop at the Tear Road Stage.
